messages.content: Implement a Python function from a JSON behavioral card. The card is the only task specification. Return a JSON object with a single string field code containing executable Python source. Define solve with the card's exact signature. Use only Python's standard library. Allowed imports: math, itertools, functools, collections, heapq, bisect, statistics, fractions, operator, typing. Do not import or call NumPy, SymPy, NetworkX or any other third-party library. Do not read files, use network, introspection, eval, exec, input or print. Implement computations yourself using built-ins and the allowed standard library. Return plain JSON-compatible values, not iterators or sets; use string keys in dictionaries. Include any helper functions in the code. No tests or main block. Raise ValueError where the card requires it.

Implement this card:
{
  "algorithm": [
    "Perform BFS/DFS starting from each unvisited node to find connected components",
    "For each node, if not visited, initiate BFS to explore all reachable nodes",
    "Collect all reachable nodes as a component",
    "Sort each component lexicographically",
    "Sort the list of components lexicographically"
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "Vertices are labeled 0 to n-1",
    "Edges are distinct and unordered pairs with u < v",
    "Graph is simple (no self-loops or multiple edges)",
    "Output must be JSON-compatible (strings for vertices)",
    "Components must be internally sorted lexicographically",
    "Outer list of components must be lexicographically sorted"
  ],
  "edge_cases": [
    "n=1 with no edges: single component [\"0\"]",
    "n=2 with one edge: two components [\"0\", \"1\"]",
    "n=3 with two edges: one component [\"0\", \"1\", \"2\"]",
    "n=0: not applicable (n>=1 per contract)",
    "All nodes isolated: n components each with one node"
  ],
  "inputs": "n: integer >= 1; edges: list of distinct [u,v] pairs with 0<=u<v<n",
  "method_id": "networkx.connected_components",
  "output": "List of lists of vertex strings, each inner list sorted lexicographically, outer list sorted lexicographically",
  "purpose": "Generate connected components for an und:graph with n nodes and edges list",
  "signature": "solve(n, edges)"
}
